name: Headless Horseman drops the CoA level-60 loot at live rates (#10228)
contract: As on live CoA, the Headless Horseman rolls The Horseman's Helm and Blade at 5% and the Hallow Band, The Horseman's Signet Ring, Witches Band and Ring of Ghoulish Delight at 2.5% each instead of a guaranteed stock level-80 ring, so about 18% of kills yield a rare or better item. The Horseman's Seal keeps its stock RequiredLevel 80.

steps.label: About 18% of Horseman kills yield a rare or better item, not every kill
